requirements.statement: Define sourced visual identity, logo/imagery/icon rules and marketing/product applications.
acceptance_criteria: Separate live observations, existing guidance and proposed extensions, including current logo provenance and navy reconciliation.
Retain Spectral/Raleway and identifiable brand colors without presenting invented logo variants or unverified claims as approved.

requirements.statement: Define personality, voice, message hierarchy and practical marketing/product copy.
acceptance_criteria: Include marketing headline/body/CTA and product label, empty, error, success and permission examples.
Label synthetic examples and avoid unsupported performance claims.

requirements.statement: Provide semantic foundations exported consistently as CSS and JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Cover color, typography, spacing, grid, radius, elevation, motion and focus with matching CSS/JSON names and values.
Identify original brand colors and proposed semantic colors, with explicit contrast-safe orange guidance.

requirements.statement: Document the core component families with reference examples and usage contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Cover actions/links; input/select/checkbox/radio/switch; badge/status/alert/toast/card; table/tabs/pagination; dialog/navigation.
For each family, specify usage, applicable variants/sizes, anatomy, content, states, behavior and accessibility notes.

requirements.statement: Specify applicable interaction, validation and business feedback/permission states.
acceptance_criteria: Cover default, hover, focus, disabled, loading, selected and validation states, explicitly identifying inapplicable cases.
Cover empty/loading/error/success/restricted business states, clear destructive confirmation and honest simulated actions.

requirements.statement: Compose a synthetic business task and compact marketing expression with traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Business composition includes navigation, search/filtering, a data table, a detail/action surface and feedback using documented components/tokens.
Label synthetic values/actions and map stable screen or section IDs to all requirements.

requirements.statement: Define and verify wide/narrow responsive behavior for core layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Define responsive gallery, navigation, form, overlay and table behavior.
Inspect 1280px desktop and 390px mobile references; prevent obscuring page-wide overflow and document contained table scrolling.

requirements.statement: Document WCAG 2.2 AA design expectations and evidence limits.
acceptance_criteria: Specify keyboard order, focus, names/labels, validation, status announcements, contrast, non-color cues, target-size and reflow decisions.
Record actual contrast and keyboard/reference checks with limits; do not claim blanket accessibility conformance.

requirements.statement: Deliver an inspectable reference with honest demo behavior and usable asset fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Provide gallery navigation, component/state index, included file paths and documented validation evidence.
Included links/controls behave to the stated demo extent, inert/illustrative/simulated elements are distinguished, and network assets have usable fallbacks.

requirements.statement: Define adoption, contribution, ownership and versioning guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Include proposed ownership, stable naming, component selection/addition, semantic version/change-log and migration guidance with a first-adoption checklist.
Keep proposal status, unvalidated implementation and adoption assumptions explicit without inventing measured benefits.

handoff_notes: Draft v1 ready for UX problem-framing review; coordinator maps requirement IDs to UX screens after proposal.
Working defaults are explicitly unvalidated: mixed marketing/business audience, one identity, light-first, English, desktop tasks with mobile usability.
No production implementation, publishing or external approval is implied. Final system owner, framework and production validation remain adoption decisions.
No approvals recorded. A current package fingerprint is required before final independent review.
